content: Yɛsu anà ndwääl a bɔr
Yɛsu kàlwomà nde apan, nde kàkyen itiir a nsi a Yuday, u sim a Yɔrdan lumwɛy. In'sɛŋ a baar myàfàköŋ apà nde, nde kàfalɔɔŋà asànaa nkääl ande.
Amfarisi bàsin tsütsü apà nde ntɔn mukun'fuul naa : « Nkye mbwo yàmwo baal muböŋ un'kyay ande. »
Yɛsu kafuur naa: « Ininà Mɔsɛ kàlaswɛŋ? »
Ba bàtɛn naa: « Mɔsɛ kàpɛ mbwo musɔn ukaan a nkaabà anà muböŋ un'kaar. »
Yɛsu waa kàtɛn a ba naa: « Yà ntɔn bwoor a mpem abɛ waa nde kàlapɛ nswɛɛŋ ayi.
Wɛɛ u nsɛmà a nkyeer, Nzam "kakyer baal anà un'kaar".
"Lalan baal asàwɛy taarànde anà ngwän, waa usàbääb a un'kyay ande,
waa ba bàbɔ̈ɔ̈l bàsabulà ndür mwɛy. Apan, ba bàfàkal anki abɔ̈ɔ̈l, wɛɛ ndür mwɛy.
Abun, wɛy mbuur ukɔɔn akaab ayi kàtüüb Nzam." »
Mpal bàkäl ba u ndwà, alɔŋki bàfun'fuul ntɔn ndaa ayi.
Nde kàtɛn a ba naa: « Baal usàwɛy un'kyay ande, usàbääl un'kyay asin, nde kan'tà inswem akà wàtàtwɛb.
Isàkal naa un'kaar kan'wɛy un'dim ande, usàwal wàsin, nde wà un'kaar inswem. »
Yɛsu anà baan
Baar bàtwäälà baan ntɔn nde kabä, wɛɛ alɔŋki bàŋän ba.
Mpal kàmɛn nde abun, Yɛsu kàmɛn ube, waa kàtɛn a ba naa: « Làwɛy baan bàyi akà mɛ! Twon làmatsuŋ, ntɔn Imwol a Nzam kye a baar abà asànaa ba.
Ndandaa mɛ alàkyään, mbuur mpà awal Imwol a Nzam asànaa mwan, nde kya usàbilà anki. »
Ungö, nde kàbööbà baan, waa kasi an'kɔɔ ntɔn mukasaak.
Ŋun'naaŋ
Mpal kàkäl Yɛsu mukyà, mbuur mwɛy kàyi u ntiin, waa kàbü an'köm kusà ande, waa kun'fuul naa: « Un'lɔɔŋ aŋàbwaŋ, mɛ in'kyer aben muwal bweel a mɔ̈ɔ̈ a mbul a in'tye? »
Yɛsu kàtɛn a nde naa: « Ntɔn nkye aman'bel ngye aŋàbwaŋ? Akà mbuur mwɛy wàŋàbwaŋ watɛy isàkal naa kà Nzam mpɛl anki.
Ngye akiyöb in'kɔɔn: "Twon an'dwà, twon an'tà inswem, twon an'yib, twon an'tà imbäl a loor, twon an'kyer mbuur ube, sà làkoo akà taaràŋà anà ngwa." »
Mbuur waa kun'fuur naa: « Un'lɔɔŋ, ayin yanswà mɛ in'kyer afàlab sɛmà imbɛy amɛ. »

Yɛsu kun'ler nde, waa kun'kwen, waa kàtɛn a nde naa: « Undiir mwɛy mpɛl kàmakɔ̈ɔ̈n: kyen, yälà indiir angye byanswà, pà ngim ya akà aŋàlàmbwà, waa ngye asàwal un'naaŋ u du. Ungö apan, yan'läb. »
Wɛɛ u ndaa ayi, nde kàbü mpye, waa kàkyen u ngyɛb mbɔɔn. Ntɔn nde kàkäl anà indiir mbɔɔn.
Yɛsu kàler umbil ande, waa kàtɛn a alɔŋki ande naa: « Yà mpay mbɔɔn akà aŋin'naaŋ mubilà kà Imwol a Nzam! »
Alɔŋki bàmɛn mpay ntɔn ndaa ande. Wɛɛ Yɛsu kàfàtɛn a ba naa: « Baan amɛ, yà mpay mbɔɔn mubilà kà Imwol a Nzam!
Mpay yatɛy mbɔɔn akà mpoonà mubilà u mun a nsway akwànaa ŋun'naaŋ mubilà kà Imwol a Nzam. »
Ba bakyer abem mbɔɔn, waa bàtɛɛnà ba a ba naa: « Abun, nà kan'kwo muwà mɔ̈ɔ̈? »
Yɛsu kaler, waa kàtɛn naa: « Ya ikwe anki akà baar, wɛɛ akà Nzam yanswà ikyer afàkwo. »
Petɔlà kàsɛmà mutɛn a nde naa: « Le bi, bi kàkyàwɛy indiir byanswà ntɔn mulab ngye. »
Yɛsu waa kàtɛn a nde naa: « Ndandaa mɛ alàkyään, isàkal naa mbuur an'sàwɛy ndwà, atɔŋ abaal, atɔŋ akaar, ngwän, taarànde, baan, an'ywaŋ ntɔn mɛ anà ntɔn Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ,
nde asàwal mbalà nkam aŋàsöönà u paŋà alà, ndwà, atɔŋ abaal, atɔŋ akaar, ngwän, baan, an'ywaŋ, - anà nkwaaŋ - anà u paŋà làyà, mɔ̈ɔ̈ a mbul a in'tye.
Lalan, bàtàtwɛb mbɔɔn bàsàkal bàngöngö, bàngöngö bàsàkal bàtàtwɛb. »
Yɛsu kan'kyään nkweel anà ngwiiyà ande mbalà yàtär

Ba bàkäl u mbwo mubeenà Yɛlusàlɛm. Yɛsu kàyikyeenà kusà a ba. Ba bàkäl mutɛɛr, baar bàyun'labà bàkal u bɔɔmà. Apan nde kàfàwal Bàkwem Aŋiyweel anà nde, waa kàsɛmà mukakyään ndaa ayà ikun'bweel:
« Le, bi iwàmubeenà Yɛlusàlɛm, akun Mwan a mbuur bàkyer akun'yälà akà amfum angaŋ anà akà alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn. Ba bàkun'tsüül mbar a ukwà, waa bàkun'yälà kan'kɔɔ a baar mpa abà Ayudà,
bàkyer akun'sɛ, bàkyer akun'tsul an'te, bàkyer akun'kam an'füm anà bàkyer akun'dwa, wɛɛ ungö a ilä itär, nde akyer asàwiyà. »
Ndɔ̈ɔ̈m a Zyak anà Ywan
Apan, Zyak anà Ywan, baan a Zebeday, bàkyen tsütsü apà Yɛsu, waa bàtɛn a nde naa: « Un'lɔɔŋ, bi ikwen naa ngye akyer ntɔn bi undiir kalɔ̈ɔ̈m bi. »
Nde waa kàtɛn a ba naa: « Ininà bɛ làkwen naa mɛ in'kyer ntɔn bɛ? »
Ba bun'fuur naa: « Ipɛ mbwo bi mubwaay u làkoo angye, umwɛy u kɔɔ angye là ibaal, wumwɛy u kɔɔ angye là ikaar. »
Yɛsu kàtɛn a ba naa: « Bɛ làyöbà anki undiir làlɔɔmà bɛ. Nkye bɛ làn'kwo munwà kɔɔb a mpay in'yànwà mɛ, itàkal naa muwal ndüümà ayin'yàwal mɛ? »
Ba bàtɛn a nde naa: « Bi kan'kwo. » Yɛsu waa kàtɛn a ba naa: « Kɔɔb in'yànwà mɛ, bɛ làkyer ayànwà la, ndüümà in'wal mɛ, bɛ làkyer ayàwal ya.
Wɛɛ mubwaay u kɔɔ amɛ là ibaal itàkal là ikaar, kà mɛ anki an'kwo mupà: ikal abi byà ntɔn baar kàlɔ̈ɔ̈n Nzam bya. »
Bàkwen bumwɛy bàwem ba ndaa ayin, ba bàmɛn Zyak anà Ywan ube.
Apan Yɛsu kabel, waa kàtɛn a ba naa: « Bɛ, bɛ làkyàyöb naa baar bàfàmɛnà asànaa amfum a in'sɛŋ bàfasà ungyɛl a in'kɔl aba, baar an'köl an'köl bàfàswaŋ ba ikɔ̈b aba.
Ya ikwe anki mukal abwɛy uboo abɛ. Wɛɛ isàkal naa mbuur akwen mukal wàkölàköl uboo abɛ, wɛy nde ukäl un'syääl abɛ,
mbuur wanswà akwen mukal wàtàtwɛb uboo abɛ, nde akal un'sɔ a baar banswà.
Lalan Mwan a mbuur kàyi anki ntɔn bun'syääl, wɛɛ nde kàyi ntɔn musyääl anà mupà mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande asànaa nkwiy ntɔn baar mbɔɔn. »
Yɛsu kan'kɔɔr ikwàmii Bartimɛ
Ba bàtöl Yɛlikɔ. Umpal kàkäl Yɛsu mutoo u bul alan anà alɔŋki ande anà un'sɛŋ a baar mbɔɔn, ikwàmii Bartimɛ, mwan baal a Timɛ, kàkäl aŋàbwaay ukɔl a mbwo mulɔɔmà.
Mpal kàwem nde naa awɛy Yɛsu un'nsi Nasàlɛr kàkäl, nde kàsɛmà mukuub in'kwɛŋ: « Mwan a David, Yɛsu, nsyääm! »
Bàmbɔɔn bun'swɛŋà naa nde ukäl akul, wɛɛ nde kàsöönà mulaal: « Mwan a David, nsyääm! »
Yɛsu waa kàmbär, waa kàtɛn naa: « Lun'bel! » Ba bàbel ikwàmii, waa bàtɛn a nde naa: « Wal ibaal, mbarà, nde kàmabel. »
Apàn, nde kàpiy kàzak ande, waa kàmbarà, kàparà ntiin mukyà akà Yɛsu.
Yɛsu kun'fuul naa: « Ininà ngye akwen mɛ mukyer ntɔn ngye? » Ikwàmii kun'fuur naa: « Un'lɔɔŋ, wɛy mɛ in'fàman! »
Yɛsu kàtɛn a nde naa: « Kyen, làkwikilà angye làmatswà mɔ̈ɔ̈. » Apan sye nde waa kàfàman, waa kàyilabà Yɛsu u mbwo.
